subject: Reverts hashHashtableTypeValidate signature (#2799)
reason: The change only reverts the C signature of hashHashtableTypeValidate from 'entry *' to 'void *' and adds an equivalent local cast, restoring type compatibility with the hashtableType.validateEntry callback declared in server.c. The function body and all runtime behaviour are identical; it is a type-correctness refactor with no observable behaviour change, so no scenario can distinguish the two builds.
